lines: You beat the Hall standing on our floor. Half the paving in this city is our slag.
Take that how you like. I meant it kindly.
A hundred and forty years lit. My great-grandmother’s mark is on the first page of the first ledger.
We do not own the heat. We are only the ones standing closest to it.

ef_foundry_pourer: Behind the copper line. I will not say it twice, and neither will the metal.
ef_foundry_tally: Eleven crates out this quarter to a Foundation address, and not one of them was ours.
We only let them use the yard. They pay very well for the yard.
ef_foundry_apprentice: Two years sweeping before they let you near a mould. I am nineteen months in.
